'Good Evening, Mr. Lu,' he said, the corners of his mouth quivering. Lu seemed astonished. records.translation: pause 400/speak Elliott "Matapos ang di-mabilang na oras ng pagsusulat sa mesa ko, inihaharap ko ang una kong aklat: 'Asul na Tore'...
